To perform a Sealing Ceremony, you must have already defeated Gouma at least once.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that caused the game to become unresponsive on the Select Hero to Play screen and in the Hall of Bonded Souls under certain conditions in the Steam version after the background video on the title screen and in the Great Hall failed to play properly.
Added the new heroes Ryu Hayabusa, Ayane, Rachel, and Momiji.

Added the new game mode Training Hall.: Note that to challenge yourself in the Training Hall, you must have already defeated Gouma at least once.: The highest Traversal Level you can attempt in the Training Hall is the max Level where you have defeated Gouma with any hero in normal playthroughs.: You can also obtain a First Completion Reward for each Traversal Level completed in the Training Hall.

Added the new game mode Void of Ephemerality.: The option "The Depths and the Void" will be added to the Great Hall, and from there you can select either the Depths of Torment or the Void of Ephemerality.: Note that to challenge yourself in the Void of Ephemerality, you must first defeat Gouma and save your stats as a Soul Record on the Results screen.: Depending on the results of your run in the Void of Ephemerality, you can also obtain Records of Sin.

Added the timed battle mode Void of Ephemerality in response to high demand from players.: Unlike in the Depths of Torment, Trials triggered during each Phase in the Void of Ephemerality will not weaken the player hero. The game will end when the time runs out, but the time limit will be extended slightly each time you defeat powerful enemies like One-eyed Ogres, so you'll have to use more aggressive strategies to achieve victory.: To make it more beneficial to complete difficult missions where you fight strong enemies like One-eyed Ogres in the Depths of Torment, we have added treasure chests with additional Spirit Essence that appear only after the mission is complete.: You can obtain Records of Sin based on the amount of Spirit Essence you have acquired in both of these modes, giving you the freedom to select whichever play style is more enjoyable for you.

Made it possible to activate Transcendence, a feature allowing you to upgrade your heroes to even greater heights.: In the Hall of Bonded Souls, you can expend Karma Embers to activate Transcendence for heroes whose Unique Weapons have been unlocked. You can also deactivate Transcendence, which will return all of your expended Karma Embers.: Transcendence is a new element added in response to requests for ways to permanently upgrade heroes.: While it costs a large amount of Karma Embers, it enables upgrades in the form of additional Emblems for heroes with fewer Emblems, changes to Unique Tactics with limited usability, and expansions to strategy based on each hero's unique characteristics. It will also offer status enhancements, so activating it can be a strategic way to challenge yourself in Traversal Levels that were once too difficult to complete. Deactivating Transcendence will also reimburse all of your expended Karma Embers.: Activate Transcendence for a variety of heroes to see how it benefits you the most.

Made it possible raise a hero's Cumulative Level by expending Karma Embers in the Hall of Bonded Souls.: This feature was also added in response to player requests.: When the Cumulative Level is increased to certain points, the hero's status will also increase. This affects the amount of damage dealt by summonable heroes when their Summoning Skill is activated, which increases the Cumulative Levels of various heroes whenever you attempt difficult Traversal Levels, giving you an edge in battle.

Increased Attack by 50% for heroes with Unique Weapons, regardless of whether they are the player hero or a summonable hero.: In the previous update, there was a bug that increased Attack by 100% regardless of whether the required conditions had been fulfilled if you had Player Hero Traits, Unique Tactics, or Records of Sin with the following effects: • Increases Attack by 〇〇% towards enemies with Burn.: • Increases Attack by 〇〇% towards enemies with Freeze.: • Increases Attack by 〇〇% towards enemies with Shock.: • Increases Attack by 〇〇% towards enemies with Disorient.: This bug significantly affected the balance of game stats and also greatly widened the gap between heroes' ability levels. In fixing this bug, the play feel will change greatly for heroes like Ginchiyo Tachibana and Mature Yukimura Sanada, who were added in the previous update and whose Traits include those listed above.: For this reason, we have fixed the bug, but we have also made changes so that Attack will increase by 50% for all heroes whose Unique Weapon has been acquired and by 100% when Transcendence is activated.

Made the following adjustments in regard to King's Cauldrons: • King's Cauldrons now appear after the defeat of Level Bosses in the Desolate Expanse.: • The number of heroes who appear at King's Cauldrons will not decrease for Traversal Level 2 and above.: • The amount of Tears of Blood paid at King's Cauldrons at each Traversal Level has been adjusted.: Previously, there were cases where King's Cauldron portals never appeared during a single playthrough, giving the player no chance to spend their hard-earned Tears of Blood before the game ended. Therefore, we made adjustments so that a King's Cauldron will always appear after a Level Boss has been defeated in the Desolate Expanse.: Additionally, because fewer heroes appeared at King's Cauldrons in higher Traversal Levels, it became less beneficial to choose King's Cauldron portals and or to activate Traits and Unique Tactics that provide Tears of Blood. For this reason, we made adjustments to prevent a decrease in heroes appearing across all Traversal Levels.
